Chapter 1

The host opened the evening in English and invited everyone to sit near the fire.

Bonsoir, mes amis. Merci d'etre venus ce soir pour notre petite lecture.

The narrator returned to English and described the candlelight on the table.

Hola, gracias por venir esta noche. Esta historia cambia de idioma con calma.

The chapter closes in English with a steady voice and a short pause.
